Rugged and Ready.

Built for Demanding Jobs and Dependable Performance.

The 2024 KIOTI DK5510MB is a versatile and tough utility tractor designed for those who need reliable horsepower without the extra frills. Powered by a 55 HP diesel engine and featuring a mechanical 8×8 shuttle transmission, this model is ideal for loader work, rotary cutting, field prep, and general land maintenance. With an open ROPS platform, it gives you simplicity, visibility, and serious working power.

From farms to work sites, the DK5510MB is made to handle the job with confidence.

Features may include:

Proven Diesel Performance
55 HP KIOTI 3-cylinder diesel engine delivers solid torque and long-lasting durability for heavy-duty tasks.

Manual Shuttle Transmission
Mechanical 8F/8R shuttle provides smooth control for loader operations and routine field work.

Heavy-Lift 3-Point Hitch
Category I/II hitch with 3,527 lbs of lift capacity supports a wide range of implements.

Independent PTO System
540 RPM PTO with convenient engagement for mowing, tilling, or digging with consistent power.

Operator-Focused Design
Open station ROPS, wide foot deck, and ergonomic controls create a practical, efficient workspace.

4WD & Power Steering
Standard four-wheel drive and hydrostatic steering enhance traction and maneuverability on varied terrain.

Dual Hydraulic Remotes
Support demanding implements and allow greater flexibility with attachments.
